definitions.short: Zecarjah , the name of twenty-nine Israelites
definitions.full: H2148. Zkaryah זְכַרְיָהוּ , oftener זְכַרְיָה proper name, masculine (Sabean ידֿכראל DHM Epigr. Denkm. 43 ) ᵐ5 Ζαχαρια ( ς ), etc.: — 1 זכריהו , king of Israel, son of Jeroboam II, 2Kin 15:8 = זכריה 14:29 ; 15:11 . 2 זכריהו , father of Hezekiah's mother 2Chr 29:1 = זכריה 2Kin 18:2 . 3 זכריהו , contemporary of Isaiah Isa 8:2 . 4 זכריהו , a Reubenite 1Chr 5:7 . 5 זכריה , a Benjamite 1Chr 9:37 ( ᵐ5 Ζαχαρια , A Ζαχχουρ ᵐ5 L Ζεχρει ) = זָ֑כֶר 8:31 (see [I. זֶכֶר ]). 6 זכריהו , a Manassite 1Chr 27:21 ( ᵐ5 Ζαβδειου , ᵐ5 L Ζαχαριου ). 7 זכריהו , a son of Jehoshaphat 2Chr 21:2 . 8 זכריה , a captain of Jehosh. 2Chr 17:7 . 9 זכריהו , teacher of Uzziah 2Chr 26:5 . 10 Levites , זכריהו : a. 1Chr 15:18 = זכריה 15:20 , 16:5 . b. 1Chr 24:25 . c. 1Chr 26:2 , 14 . d. 1Chr 26:11 . e. 2Chr 20:14 . f. 2Chr 29:13 ( ᵐ5 Ἀζαριας , A Ζαχαριας , so ᵐ5 L ). זכריה : g. 1Chr 9:21 . h. 2Chr 34:12 . i. an Asaphite Neh 12:35 . 11 priests , זכריהו : a. 1Chr 15:24 b. 2Chr 35:8 . זכריה : c. 2Chr 24:20 ( ᵐ5 Ἀζαριαν ; ᵐ5 L Ζαχαριαν ; probably referred to Matt 23:35 , where apparently confusion with f ). d. Neh 11:12 . e. Neh 12:41 . f. the well-known prophet Zech 1:1 , 7 ; 7:1 , 8 ; Neh 12:16 [compare Aramaic Ezra 5:1 ; 6:14 ]. 12 returned exiles , זכריה : a. Ezra 8:3 and perhaps 8:16 , compare Neh 8:4 . b. Ezra 8:11 ( ᵐ5 Ἀζαριας , A Ζαχαριας , so ᵐ5 L ). c. Ezra 10:26 . d. a man of Judah Neh 11:4 . e. id. Neh 11:5 ( ᵐ5 Θηζεια , א Θηδεια , A Ζαχαριου , so ᵐ5 L ). זְכַרְיָה proper name, masculine prophet (Biblical Hebrew id. ), Ezra 5:1 ; 6:14 .
